[Question]
How does Li Jun convince Zhang Hua?

B. Organize some well-known doctors in the field of Chinese and Western medicine combination to give lectures and exchange experiences with Zhang Hua.

D. Li Jun can share some successful cases, showing that the combination of Chinese and Western medicine brings better treatment effects.
